overview: Centre Wellington grew 10.3 per cent between 2016 and 2021 to 31,093 residents, the fastest growth in Wellington County. Its 11,972 occupied homes are split between Fergus, Elora and rural hamlets across 409 square kilometres.

Fergus carries most of the township's manufacturing and everyday shopping, while Elora draws large numbers of day-trippers to the gorge, quarry and downtown. A local business here serves a growing resident base and a seasonal visitor market, often from separate downtowns with their own identities.

byService.lead-generation: Centre Wellington's 10.3 per cent growth from 2016 to 2021 means a steady flow of new households, so lead generation should target new subdivisions in Fergus and Elora first.
byService.seo: Few people search for Centre Wellington by name, so SEO should target Fergus and Elora directly, along with visitor searches about the gorge, quarry and downtown shops.
byService.website-development: Websites here should load quickly for day-trippers on mobile data in Elora, while giving 31,093 residents clear details on hours, locations and service areas.
byService.branding: Fergus and Elora each have a distinct character, so branding should signal which community a business belongs to rather than relying on the township name.
